第十一章超青藏高原81
十八、空天航母中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟知道历史记录。
那段历史是这样记录的——翔天等人一路找寻灵魂徽章，来到一个奇怪的地方，翔天和亚树一个接一个地被敌人的巨大战舰钓上了飞船。
幸好奈奈机智地识破了敌人的布置，将计就计潜入飞船救出翔天和亚树，一举捣破了敌人的战船。
那是没有逆转时空之前的原始历史。现在不同了。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟与中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅在一起。
空灵族娑娜手下钓鱼兄弟——左钓和右钓，驾驶着一艘巨大的空天航母悬浮在龟岛上空。
左钓坐在左舷的钓台上，操控一根巨型能量钓竿，钓线由暗紫色能量束构成，能从高空精准地甩向地面，将目标连人带物一起钓上飞船。
右钓坐在右舷，同样操控一根能量钓竿，两根钓竿交替甩出，钓鱼的速度快得像两台高速运转的收割机。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天被左钓的能量钓线钩中腰部，整个人从地面被提上半空。
他试图挣扎，但钓线紧紧缠住了他的召唤器腕带。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树紧跟着被右钓的钓线钩中脚踝，倒吊着被拖上空天航母。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈和中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅同样没有逃过钓线的追击，先后被钓上了飞船。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟没有被钓。
他们提前启动了星卡的伪装能力，在钓鱼兄弟的探测系统中看起来像是岛上的普通岩石。
四人迅速制定计划——不是上船救人，而是上船协助前辈们直接摧毁空天航母。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈被钓上空天航母后，很快就识破了敌人的布置。
第十一章超青藏高原81
她故意装作被钓线捆住无法动弹，实际上手腕已经悄悄转动，将召唤器调整到了激活位置。
等左钓的钓线稍微松开的瞬间，她翻身站起，徽章插入召唤器。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈抬起右腕，召唤器固定在手腕上，徽章插在召唤器中。
“流影飞狐！”元气金刚流影飞狐在空天航母的甲板上拔地而起，冰蓝装甲在暗紫色的船舱中亮得刺眼。
流影神弓在手中，流影箭——十二支冰蓝色能量箭同时离弦，击碎了左钓的钓竿操控台。

与此同时，白元勇者们也登上了空天航母。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧召唤猛风与白光狼，中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖召唤地震龙，中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯召唤光影飞虎。
六尊金刚加白光狼在空天航母的甲板上一字排开。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天挣脱钓线，召唤烈风与金光狮。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树召唤震地龙。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅站在甲板边缘，开始唱歌。
猫人族的旋律在空天航母的金属墙壁之间反弹，干扰了左钓和右钓的通讯频率。
烈风与猛风并肩冲向空天航母的控制塔。神光烈风斩与天光猛风斩同时斩下，红黑剑气与赤蓝剑气交织，将控制塔的外壁装甲斩碎。
震地龙与地震龙双钻头同时启动，从甲板中央钻入船体内部，破坏了空天航母的动力核心。
流影飞狐与光影飞虎双弓齐发，流影箭与光影箭封锁了左钓和右钓的逃生路线。
金光狮狮吼激光炮从狮子口中喷出金色光束，击穿了右钓的钓竿操控台。
白光狼狼嚎爆破斩——星月弯刀斩下，银白刀光斩碎了空天航母的主桅杆。
空天航母在多重攻击下开始倾斜，暗紫色能量从破裂的动力核心中泄漏出来。
左钓和右钓试图启动备用引擎，但中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖操控地震龙钻入引擎室，天钻爆裂——双钻头合并，带着银白色光膜撞入了备用引擎的核心。
备用引擎炸裂，空天航母彻底丧失动力。八个人在空天航母坠毁之前跳回地面，空天航母在龟岛上空炸成一团暗紫色的烟花。
左钓和右钓失败了。钓鱼兄弟随着空天航母的残骸一同坠落。

Chapter 11 Beyond the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 81
18. Aerospace Carrier The little girl Huang Xuejing who is a brave person in the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, the little girl Yang Xinying who is the power in the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, the little boy Tang Qiongkai who is the wise brave man in the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, and the little boy Hu Wei who is a panda beast in the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World know the historical records.
That period of history is recorded like this - Xiangtian and others searched for the soul badge all the way and came to a strange place. Xiangtian and Yashu were caught one by one by the enemy's huge battleship and boarded the spacecraft.
Fortunately, Nana was smart enough to see through the enemy's plan, and used the trick to sneak into the spacecraft to rescue Xiangtian and Yashu, destroying the enemy's warship in one fell swoop.
That was the original history before time and space were reversed. It's different now. Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan World of Power, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan Brave World, a giant panda beast boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan World, and Hu Wei, a little boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology Thunderbolt Warrior The little boy Xiangtian from the world of vitality brave warriors, the little boy Yashu from the world of vitality brave warriors from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors of China, the little girl Tian Nana from the world of wisdom and bravery from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors from China, and the little girl Meiya from the cat-human race who is the leader of the world of vitality braves from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors from China are together.
The fishing brothers Zuo Diao and You Diao under Sona of the Void Tribe drove a huge aerospace aircraft carrier suspended over Turtle Island.
Zuo Diao is sitting on the fishing platform on the port side, controlling a giant energy fishing rod. The fishing line is composed of dark purple energy beams. It can be accurately thrown to the ground from high altitude, and the target can be fished onto the spacecraft together with people and objects.
Sitting on the starboard side, he also controls an energy fishing rod. The two fishing rods are thrown out alternately, and the fishing speed is as fast as two high-speed harvesters.
The young boy Xiangtian was hooked in the waist by Zuo Diao's energy fishing line, and his whole body was lifted into the air from the ground.
He tried to struggle, but the line tightened around his summoner wristband. The little boy Yashu was hooked in the ankle by the right fishing line and was dragged upside down onto the aerospace aircraft carrier.
Tian Nana, a little girl from China's low-level technological Thunderbolt Warriors: The World of Vitality and Brave Warriors, and the leader of the world of vitality and bravery, the little girl Meiya from the cat tribe, also did not escape the pursuit of the fishing line, and were caught on the spaceship one after another.
Huang Xuejing, a little girl from the Chinese low-level science and technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Chinese low-level science and technology White Yuan Brave World, Tang Qiongkai, a little boy from the Chinese low-level science and technology White Yuan Brave World, and Hu Wei, a little panda boy from the Chinese low-level science and technology White Yuan Brave World, were not caught.
They activated the camouflage ability of the star card in advance, making it look like an ordinary rock on the island in the detection system of the fishing brothers.
The four people quickly formulated a plan - not to get on the ship to rescue people, but to get on the ship to assist their predecessors in directly destroying the aerospace aircraft carrier.
The little girl Tian Nana quickly saw through the enemy's arrangement after being lured onto the aerospace aircraft carrier.
Chapter 11 Beyond the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 81
She deliberately pretended to be tied up by the fishing line and unable to move. In fact, she had quietly turned her wrist and adjusted the summoner to the active position.
The moment Zuo Diao's fishing line loosened slightly, she turned over and stood up, inserting the badge into the summoner. The little girl Tian Nana raised her right wrist, the summoner was fixed on her wrist, and the badge was inserted into the summoner.
"Liuying Flying Fox!" The vitality King Kong Liuying Flying Fox rises from the ground on the deck of the aerospace aircraft carrier, and the ice blue armor is dazzling in the dark purple cabin.
The flowing shadow bow is in the hand, flowingShadow Arrows - Twelve ice-blue energy arrows left the string at the same time, shattering Zuo Diao's fishing rod control console.
At the same time, the Baiyuan Braves also boarded the aerospace carrier. The little girl Huang Xuejing, a brave girl from the White Yuan Brave World of China's low-level technology, summons fierce winds and white light wolves, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the Power of the White Yuan Brave World of China's low-level technology, summons an earthquake dragon, and Tang Qiongkai, a brave boy from the Wisdom of the White Yuan Brave World of China's low-level technology, summons a flying tiger of light and shadow.
Six Vajras and white-light wolves were lined up on the deck of the space aircraft carrier. The young boy Xiangtian breaks away from the fishing line and summons the gale wind and the golden lion.
China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's Vitality Brave World Power Brave's little boy Yashu summons the Earthshaking Dragon.
Meiya, a little girl from the cat tribe, stood on the edge of the deck and began to sing.
The melody of the cat people bounced between the metal walls of the aerospace carrier, interfering with the communication frequencies of Zuo Diao and Right Diao.
Gale and fierce winds rushed side by side towards the control tower of the aerospace aircraft carrier. Divine Light Gale Wind Slash and Sky Light Gale Wind Slash were slashed at the same time. The red and black sword energy intertwined with the red and blue sword energy, shredding the outer armor of the control tower into pieces.
The twin drills of Earthquake Dragon and Earthquake Dragon were activated at the same time, drilling into the interior of the hull from the center of the deck, destroying the power core of the aerospace aircraft carrier.
The Liuying Flying Fox and the Light and Shadow Flying Tiger fired their bows at the same time, and the Liuying Arrow and the Light and Shadow Arrow blocked the escape routes of Zuo Diao and Right Diao.
The golden lion's roaring laser cannon ejected a golden beam of light from the lion's mouth and penetrated the right fishing rod control console.
White light Wolf Howl Explosive Slash - The Xingyue Scimitar slashed down, and the silver-white sword light shattered the main mast of the aerospace aircraft carrier.
The aerospace carrier began to tilt under multiple attacks, and dark purple energy leaked from the cracked power core.
Zuo Diao and Right Diao tried to start the backup engine, but the little girl Yang Xinying, who was a member of the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, controlled the earthquake dragon to drill into the engine room. The sky diamond exploded - the twin drills merged and crashed into the core of the backup engine with a silvery white light film.
The backup engine exploded and the aerospace carrier completely lost power. Eight people jumped back to the ground before the aerospace carrier crashed, and the aerospace carrier exploded into a dark purple firework over Turtle Island.
The left and right fishing failed. The fishing brothers fell together with the wreckage of the aerospace aircraft carrier.
